thesis: Authentic spiritual experience and its metaphysical interpretation require different evaluation.

ideas.statement: Personal significance does not automatically authorize coercion; testable paranormal claims need predefined protocols and replication, while anomalies do not identify their own cause.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The hidden-image test is an unperformed design example; neural basis neither disproves an external object nor establishes divine causation when incomplete.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The hidden-image test is an unperformed design example; neural basis neither disproves an external object nor establishes divine causation when incomplete.

audit.notes: All source units read directly; normative proposals and inferred risks remain labeled.
